description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Clever Impersonator.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Clever Impersonator and another permanent you control.
Activate Clever Impersonator by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Clever Impersonator
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
